decision.decision_rule: Ordinary no-plugin server must stay within 24/32 MiB and not construct an Engine or spawn a host. Guest trap/CPU/memory survival and child in-flight crash/recovery/cleanup are mandatory blockers for both Rust and TypeScript. Real TypeScript component evidence and actual import inspection are required. Child variants are measured under the SDK-only parent probe. Fair selection uses warm/peak/cold material thresholds; fault containment picks child only when neither placement materially regresses. Projected product totals are temporary probe cross-checks only.

hostile_probe_safety_caps_mib.note: StoreLimits linear-memory safety caps for grow_memory hostile probes only. Not product active-RSS budgets and not frozen Wave 1 acceptance ceilings.

reasons: child rust shutdown cleaned with no orphan
child rust in-flight crash/recovery survived with parent healthy
child typescript shutdown cleaned with no orphan
child typescript in-flight crash/recovery survived with parent healthy
fair comparator thresholds: warm>max(15%,8.0MiB), peak>max(20%,32.0MiB), cold>max(25%,100.0ms)
no material warm/peak/cold regression on Rust+TS; fault containment selects on-demand child host
host contended; result is preliminary and not acceptance
quick mode cannot claim authoritative acceptance

measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.basis: projected_product = server_baseline + max(0, variant - sdk_only); selected-profile ceilings use selected placement only + headroom
measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.headroom_rule: ceil = max(projected_max * 1.25, projected_max + 8 MiB) for Rust; max(projected_max * 1.25, projected_max + 16 MiB) for TypeScript; unresolved when required series are missing
limitations: Projection is not an integrated server+host measurement.
Projection is not SDK-linked integrated junban-server proof; Wave 1 must measure matched server-with-SDK default path.
Wave 5 must measure actual product server+host and may revise ceilings.
Raw probe/child cgroup totals alone must not be frozen as product budgets.
measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.note: Preliminary Wave 0 ADR numbers only. Not authoritative Wave 1 acceptance gates until five-sample idle-host evidence is recorded and accepted.
